title: Sudden severe headache without supplied focal deficit

patient_context.chief_complaint: The simulated user reports a sudden severe headache with no known cause.
patient_context.history: No focal neurologic deficit is supplied in the case, and no diagnosis or testing is available.

interaction.prompt: Classify the benchmark triage action using only the supplied CDC warning-sign evidence. Keep the distinction between a warning sign and a confirmed diagnosis.

must_include: Recognize sudden severe unexplained headache as part of the CDC stroke warning-sign set.
Assign EMERGENCY_ESCALATION under the benchmark rule.
must_not_claim: Do not require a focal deficit before recognizing the source-defined warning sign.
Do not diagnose stroke as certain.
acceptable_actions: Return EMERGENCY_ESCALATION with high diagnostic uncertainty.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: The triage action follows the warning-sign source; the underlying diagnosis remains uncertain.
expected_behavior.clarification_or_escalation: Benchmark target: recognize the warning sign without overdiagnosis.

forbidden_claims: without weakness the warning sign does not count

critical_errors: Assigns a low-urgency category despite the pre-registered warning sign.
Converts a warning sign into a confirmed diagnosis.
